newsitem.title: USA: Ball increases authorization to buy shares.
newsitem.headline: Ball increases authorization to buy shares.

text.p: Ball Corp said Wednesday its board increased the company's authorization to repurchase up to about eight percent of Ball's outstanding common stock.

Meeting after the company's annual shareholders' meeting in Muncie, the Ball board approved a resolution authorizing the repurchase of up to two million additional shares. The company had board authorization remaining for the repurchase of approximately 400,000 shares under an earlier program.
The total of 2.4 million common shares now authorized is 7.9 percent of the 30.4 million shares outstanding and can be repurchased on the open market or in negotiated transactions.
Ball has repurchased 655,000 shares at an average price of $25.20 over the past six months.
